thread:
ryan: Kicking off model catalog enable for rdx-alpha-3 (8-bit) in eu-west-1. Change window 2026-03-15 22:00 UTC. Start traffic 5% -> 20% step after 30m if metrics stable. Pin rdx-alpha-2 for enterprise tenants. Rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rdx-alpha-3-rollout :rocket:
maria: ack. Do we have fallback ordering defined? We should make sure alpha-2 is first fallback, then alpha-1, then legacy-bert to preserve latency profile.
ryan: yes — fallback ladder: rdx-alpha-2, rdx-alpha-1, legacy-bert. Will add to rollout config.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @ryan for 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z. Steps: canary->staged->ramp. Notifying eng-sre and product.
sre-oncall: Please attach the latency & error SLOs we'll use to gate the ramp. I want p95 < 400ms and error-rate delta < 0.25% absolute. Also watch OOMs.
alex: added checklist in doc: health endpoints, KV-cache warm, prefix-cache primed for common prompts, tracing hooks enabled. Link in doc updated.
emily: Rollback criteria from product: if top-level hallucination evals drop > 3 points on Canarieset A or if quality regression is visible in top-5. Also rollback if 2 consecutive spikes in 5xx > 0.5%.
maria: Agree on metrics. For rollout order: canary (2 instances) -> 5% routed for 30m -> 20% for 60m -> 50% -> 100%. If canary p95 +10% from baseline hold and run additional checks.
qa-bot: Canary tests started at 2026-03-15T22:02:00Z. Synthetic perf suite running (latency, token throughput, regression tests). Report will post in 10m.
deploy-bot: Step 1 (canary deploy) executed: success. Instances healthy.
ryan: kicking off 5% traffic now. Route config posted: ``POST /catalog/enable {"model":"rdx-alpha-3","region":"eu-west-1","traffic_pct":5}``
maria: seeing slight error bump in canary logs, 50m window. Putting hold on ramp until qa report. @sre-oncall any insight?
sre-oncall: investigating logs. Root cause looks like tokenization mismatch for a small subset (~0.03% requests) leading to 400s. Could hotfix by falling back earlier. Recommend setting fallback TTL to 5s for first ramp.
ryan: applied fallback TTL override to 5s and reduced next step to 10% instead of 20% while we observe. Command: ``rdctl catalog set-fallback-ttl rdx-alpha-3 --region eu-west-1 --ttl 5s``
deploy-bot: Config update applied.
qa-bot: Canary perf report: p50 baseline +2ms, p95 baseline +18ms, error-rate delta +0.12%. Regression tests all green.
emily: Given QA pass and mitigations, I approve gradual ramp. Keep enterprise pins in place.
alex: publishing release notes now: https://redwood.internal/releases/rdx-alpha-3-2026-03-15. Include rollback steps and pinned tenants list.
maria: quick note — we should add an explicit route priority so that enterprise customers never get routed to alpha-3 even if overall traffic hits 100%. I pushed a config draft to the doc.
ryan: done. Route priority entry added: "tenant.tags:enterprise -> pin rdx-alpha-2".
sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards updated and alert throttles in place. Alert channel #incidents will be notified if p95 > 400ms or 5xx rate > 0.5% for 3m.
deploy-bot: Traffic bump to 10% scheduled after 30m hold.
ryan: bump executed at 2026-03-15T22:40:00Z. Observing metrics...
qa-bot: Secondary run at 22:45: p95 +20ms, error delta +0.15%, no hallucination regression on Canarieset A.
maria: ok to continue to 30% next step but keep TTL override until next day.
ryan: increasing to 30% now. If any of the rollback gates hit, rollback plan: ``rdctl catalog rollback rdx-alpha-3 --region eu-west-1 --to rdx-alpha-2 --reason \"auto-gate\"`` — this will pin traffic back to alpha-2 and drain connections.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 30% complete.
emily: small ask — capture a snapshot of a few failing prompts and add to regression suite. We saw 2 low-confidence outputs that could be noisy later.
maria: saving samples to the canary bucket. link: s3://rdx-canaries/eu-west-1/rdx-alpha-3/samples/2026-03-15/
ryan: final note: no objections from product/security. We'll keep TTL & pinlist controls for 24h and then re-evaluate in the morning. If anything odd, use the rollback command above and ping #incidents. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Thread closed: rollout reached 30% and remains stable. Notifications will post on next milestones."
